title: How to turn yourself into an anime character in a video
summary: Turn yourself into an original anime character with Character Replace. Choose the right workflow, prepare a licensed reference, select the subject and inspect the result.
body_markdown:
Quick Answer


## Quick answer


**To turn yourself into an anime character in a video, use Character Replace when one person should become a specific anime design, or Video-to-Video when the entire clip should adopt an anime style.** Start with a short clear video and an original or licensed reference image, select the intended person, generate, then inspect face, hands, clothing, motion and occlusions throughout the clip.


A reference image guides appearance; it does not grant rights to use an existing character or another artist’s work. For public or commercial content, create an original design or use artwork you are authorized to transform.


### Try one anime character replacement


Use a short clear source clip and an original or licensed anime reference. Select the intended person, check the estimate, and inspect every turn, hand and occlusion.


[Open Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/create/character-replace)


## Choose the correct workflow first


-


**Character Replace:** changes the wider appearance of a selected person while using the source performance and camera motion. Choose this for a specific original anime character.


-


**Video-to-Video:** restyles the whole scene while preserving the source motion and structure. Choose this for an anime look across the person and environment.


-


**Face Swap Video:** changes facial identity while leaving the wider body and clothing closer to the source. Choose this only when the intended change is the face.


Magic Hour’s current[Character Replace guide](https://help.magichour.ai/en/articles/16917099-character-replace-step-by-step-guide) explicitly distinguishes whole-character replacement from face-only replacement. Its[Video-to-Video page](https://magichour.ai/products/video-to-video) documents anime and other art-style restyling for the full clip.


## Prepare an anime reference you can legally use


-


**Use a clear face and silhouette:** front-facing or slightly angled references are easier to interpret than hidden faces or extreme crops.


-


**Match the framing:** a full-body source action needs a reference that clearly defines clothing and body design.


-


**Simplify small details:** tiny accessories, text and intricate patterns are difficult to preserve across motion.


-


**Use a plain background:** separate the character from the reference environment.


-


**Keep ownership records:** save the prompt, source files, license and creator permission with the project.


You can create an original reference with the[Magic Hour AI Image Generator](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-generator) . Describe the character, clothing, palette, line style, view and plain background. Generate several directions, then choose one coherent design rather than combining unrelated features.


Original anime character, adult, short dark hair, indigo jacket with simple silver trim, clean cel-shaded linework, neutral standing pose, full body, front three-quarter view, plain light background, no text, no logos.


[Try in AI Image Generator](https://magichour.ai/create/ai-image-generator?prompt=Original%2520anime%2520character%252C%2520adult%252C%2520short%2520dark%2520hair%252C%2520indigo%2520jacket%2520with%2520simple%2520silver%2520trim%252C%2520clean%2520cel-shaded%2520linework%252C%2520neutral%2520standing%2520pose%252C%2520full%2520body%252C%2520front%2520three-quarter%2520view%252C%2520plain%2520light%2520background%252C%2520no%2520text%252C%2520no%2520logos.)


## How to replace yourself with the anime character


### 1. Open Character Replace and sign in


Open[Character Replace](https://magichour.ai/create/character-replace) and sign in. Current availability, duration, resolution and credits depend on the account and settings shown in the editor.


### 2. Add and trim the source video


Choose a clip where the intended person remains visible and reasonably separated from other people. If trim controls appear, select the exact section before choosing the subject.


### 3. Add the replacement image


Under Character to use, upload the original or licensed anime reference. A whole-body reference is preferable when the clothing and silhouette should change.


### 4. Select the intended person


Use Select person when the video contains more than one person or Auto could be ambiguous. Move the filmstrip to a frame where the subject is visible, select them, and confirm Select This Person. If you later change the trim, recheck the selection points inside the new range.


### 5. Confirm scope, resolution and estimate


Choose the whole-character workflow, select an available resolution, and review the displayed credit estimate. Do not rely on an older article’s duration or credit figures; use the controls shown for the current account and clip.


### 6. Generate and inspect every difficult moment


Review the beginning, end, turns, crossed limbs, hands near the face, fast motion and occlusions. Download only after the intended character remains recognizable and the source performance is still readable.


## A practical quality checklist


-


**Identity:** face shape, hair, palette and signature clothing stay consistent.


-


**Motion:** limbs follow the source action without unexplained jumps.


-


**Hands and occlusions:** objects crossing the body do not merge with the character.


-


**Background:** the replacement does not bleed into walls, furniture or other people.


-


**Text and logos:** verify any visible words and brand marks; remove invented or distorted versions.


-


**Rights:** the source footage, reference, music and final use are authorized.


## Fix common failures


-


**Wrong person changed:** switch from Auto to Select person and choose a clear frame.


-


**Selection disappeared after trimming:** choose the person again inside the new trim range.


-


**Character drifts on turns:** shorten the clip, use a clearer reference, or choose source footage with less occlusion.


-


**Only the face should change:** use[Face Swap Video](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) instead of whole-character replacement.


-


**The environment should also look animated:** use Video-to-Video for the full-scene restyle.
